results.name: Every kind of failure reports itself the same way
reasons: 2 different error shapes across 4 failure kinds
results.note: Failure kinds do not share one envelope: bad metric name (400) -> 400 {error, message, status} | bad level name (400) -> 400 {error, message, status} | unsupported level for metric (400) -> 400 {error, message, status} | invalid token (401) -> 401 (empty body). A client cannot then read the reason out of a single field, which usually ends up as "something went wrong" in the UI regardless of what actually happened.
